name: Focus Medical
old_description: Welcome to Focus Medical! We are a manufacturer of best-in-class aesthetic lasers and light based devices. Our cutting-edge devices deliver precision, versatility and provide optimal results for patients. We offer lasers and light devices that are tailored to individuals specific needs. Whether you are a medspa owner or cosmetic surgeon looking to enhance your practice with advanced technology, we have the right options for you.
about:
Focus Medical, based in Bethel, Connecticut, has been developing aesthetic laser and light‑based devices for over 25 years. The company manufactures systems under the NaturaLase and NaturaLight brands, positioning itself as a technology‑leading laser manufacturer.

The product line includes the NaturaLase CO2 laser, NaturaLight IPL system, and other platforms designed for hair removal, wrinkle reduction, vascular lesions, and cosmetic treatments. The company emphasizes engineering to deliver higher energies and ease of use, reporting that it has served more than 5,000 offices with three core device platforms.

Customers include medspa owners, cosmetic surgeons, dermatologists, and distributors. Testimonials from practitioners such as Dr. Judy Hellman of Hellman Dermatology and Dr. Martin Kassir highlight clinical versatility and responsive service support.

Focus Medical describes itself as a "science first" company, aiming to be a long‑term partner for providers by offering technology that improves treatment quality and practice success. It positions its devices as alternatives to inefficient and expensive legacy systems.
